mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the exchange surface to the air spaces was worthwhile because it showed how the air route reaches the place where gases cross into and out of blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the diaphragm and rib muscles felt less engaging as a decision because it was the only offered combination, although the explanation of breathing out was useful.

surprise.text: I was interested to learn that quiet breathing out can happen as the chest and lungs spring back after the breathing muscles relax.

arbitrary.text: No action felt without a purpose, though the last three combinations were the only offered choices and required little decision-making.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: connecting air and blood routes to the arm made me curious how the body keeps supplying working cells. The guided combinations themselves offered limited challenge.
